_fl_session_config_note: EMPTY = O1-only session (the default). A pod-visible path here selects the COMBINED O1 -> Foundation Learner session; the FL package is baked into image v0.3.2+ at /opt/foundation_learner, and the named file must also be present on the pod (staged alongside the artifacts or mounted) - start_b300.sh refuses before any scientific work if either is absent. This value is DEPLOYMENT IDENTITY: it changes deployment_spec_sha256, so switching a session from O1-only to combined requires a FRESH rental authorization ceremony. Bound 2026-08-22 to the config baked with the FL source (image v0.3.11+); the first session is the COMBINED O1 -> FL session.
_profile_preference_note: Order in which the FROZEN accelerator profiles are tried. Both are covered by the rental authorization, so reordering adds no capability — it only expresses which part the operator wants FIRST. Set ["B200","B300"] to prefer the B200 (e.g. when B300 demand makes it unobtainable); the session still falls back to the other profile and records the reason. Unknown profile names are refused. First paid session: B200 FIRST — its sm_100 SASS is the directly-validated path (the sm_103 claim rests on cuobjdump evidence never exercised on hardware), and B300 showed no interruptible availability at the last read-only check.
_result_source_note: REMOVED and derived: the archive lives at result_destination + 'results/o1_results.tar.gz'. Storing it separately let the session prefix move the publish path while the driver kept reading the old one, which turned a fully successful paid run into ABORTED_TERMINATED. zero_touch.result_archive_uri() is the one source.
